name: 29455 · Johns Island, SC
findings: ZIP 29455 (Johns Island) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29455 (Johns Island) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29455 (Johns Island) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 24 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
